person_note: The book alternates sustained narrative persons: Aoife, Hannah, Jules, Olivia, Johnno, and later Will narrate character chapters in first person, while recurring “Now, The Wedding Night” sections use an external third-person narrator. The quote set strongly corroborates both modes through many participating I/we passages and externally narrated wedding-night passages such as q04461, q04481, and q04482. First-person language confined to dialogue or general maxims was not promoted to base evidence. The authorized opening visibly contains both modes, and whole-book structural sources confirm that the alternation recurs; no material uncertainty remains about the person configuration.
